messages:
rache: Heads-up: during a PTQ bring-up for sable-30b-ptq I hit a weird alignment/duplication after a large context rollover (~65k tokens). Looks like a KV pointer off-by-one when the buffer wraps and we compact.

jordi: Oof. Which compact strategy and allocator?

rache: Default ring compact + packed-int8 store from the new packer. Ran with --kv-compact=ring --quant=ptq8 --rope=scale-auto. Repro command: 
```
./bench/longrun.py --model sable-30b-ptq --quant ptq8 --max-tokens 70000 --prefill contiguous --seed 7 --rope scale-auto
```
Short snippet of generated stream around wrap: 
```
[64890] ctx-roll -> wrap -> compact
[64891] token: "and"
[64892] token: "the"
[64893] token: "the"  <-- duplicate
[64894] token: "company"
```
I expected punctuation at 64893 not a repeated "the".

emma: Did infra-bot report any OOMs or shard reshuffles?

infra-bot: node-argo05: compact succeeded, freed 18.2MB. no OOM. compaction-time=42ms. job_id=9942.

lucas: Could be an index staleness: when wrap happens, writer advances pointer before readers flush and a stale kv-index is used for next tokens. Any kernel dumps?

rache: Attached phase/key dumps at s3://redwood-ml/bench/1733000000/sable-30b-ptq/ . Ran a small diff between pre- and post-compact key hashes: some keys in shard2 have identical low-16 bits -> suspicious collision with packed pointers.

quant-runner: Quick summary from regression harness: quality delta -2.9% (token-match proxy) between tokens 64.8k and 65.4k. Repro rate ~3/10 seeds. Latency: +3% during compact windows.

jordi: Steps to triage: 1) repro with copy-full compact instead of ring 2) run with rope scaling disabled (--rope none) to see if RoPE rescale interacts 3) enable debug-checksum on KV writes 4) run with uncompressed (float16) KV to rule out packer bug.

emma: I'll run (1) and (4) on the small cluster — toggling env KV_COMPACT_STRATEGY=copy-full and KV_STORE=float16.

rache: Also adding a synthetic test that writes alternating small fragments to force wrap and then reads back a golden seq to check bitwise identity. If packer corrupts pointer math it'll show up.

lucas: If checksums diverge only under ptq8, packer likely at fault. If the same appears with float16, then pointer arithmetic or compact ordering bug.

quant-runner: Scheduling nightly matrix: {ptq8, float16} x {ring, copy-full} x {rope=scale-auto, rope=none} x seeds=10. Job 9950. Will update S3 with diff matrices.

rache: Thanks. One extra oddity: phase vectors in mid/high layers show a tiny discontinuity at wrap boundary (layer10 shard2 mean-delta spike). Might be coincidence but worth correlating.

jordi: Good. If we find packer is culprit, revert PTQ packer changes on the PTQ branch and re-run quick smoke. If pointer arithmetic, add an assert on pointer < buf_size before advance.

rache: Will collect kernel dumps & checksums and post links here once job 9950 finishes. Thanks all. :pray:
